interpretation: Lower-than-expected disagreement means the action effects under the two controllers agree more than random cross-state pairing would; the same-state I = Δ_Q − Δ_B ≠ 0 in the deterministic, replay-verified setting is non-additive interaction on the success scale; this identification does not depend on exceeding the pairing control.

definitions.pool_equal_weight: p_o and p_e = equal-weight means of the per-cell values over common complete blocks; kappa from those means
definitions.pool_count_summed: summed 3x3 counts, marginals of the summed table (labelled separately)
